unposted_issue_draft.title: Restore Codex generated-source cache hits under the original private runtime owner
unposted_issue_draft.body:
A valid accepted Codex generated-source cache hit fails before returning its materialized candidate because cache replay reconstructs command metadata without the private runtime owner required by Codex.

Observed in macOS Python3.11 and3.14 CI jobs140501673294/140501673348 on run45997696262 (PRheaddf6a725e1, actualtestedmerged8b28048). The shared cache owner is platform-neutral: generated_source._load calls delegate._command(root,model); _codex_runtime_arguments(None) raises coding_cli.runtime_state_missing. The first actual authored child and accepted publication succeed; replay must keep executions==1 and original planned candidate/provenance identities.

The v1 cache manifest does not store original spent command/command_identity. Replay has always reconstructed current output-root/model invocation metadata. Restore the original ownership requirement while constructing that metadata: use the existing bounded _coding_cli_runtime_state owner, pass its actual runtime_state to _command, and retire it on success/failure. This metadata-only scope must not probe or launch a CLI, call generate, request a model, change recipe/model/tool/cache/request pins, or skip suite/SBOM/source-intelligence/current-selection validation. Do not weaken the runtime_state guard or reuse invented/stale original-command bytes.

Acceptance: preserve the original authored cache replay test and all candidate/tree/request/tool identities and child-count assertion; prove the private state exists only during metadata construction, stays outside generated outputs, and is removed on normal/exceptional exit. Cover a real acceptedcache hit, selectednonCodex path compatibility, changedrecipe refusal, and all original cache guards. Use a portable executable fixture so shared owner coverage is not restricted to Darwin.

Separate macOS lexical TemporaryDirectory alias fixtures and native deadline failures are not part of this source defect. No full release/native-model acceptance claimed.
